messages:
danielle (PM): Heads-up — Q4 roadmap sync: we need to decide retention & tracing scope for Console Observability launch. Customer asks + internal SLOs colliding. Proposed cut: postpone deep heatmaps, keep dashboards + basic traces + 90d trace retention. Thoughts?

mike (Eng - obs): Agree we should avoid scope creep. Implementation risk on heatmaps is high (frontend + backend). 90d traces ok but need storage/cost plan. Can we do sampling instead of full retention?

tara (SRE): +1 on sampling. We can implement adaptive tail-sampling at ingestion. Rough estimate: 40-60% cost reduction vs full retention for our p50/p90 traffic.

raj (Data): If we sample, we need deterministic sampling keys so customer's funnels still correlate to traces. Also need to record sampling rate per trace for correct metrics.

sam (Design): From UX: customers asked for heatmaps for session replay, but they expect it later. Let's ship dashboards + trace waterfall and callouts for "heatmap coming soon". Keep messaging clear.

olivia (Customer Success): We have two enterprise customers on 90d requirement. They'll accept sampled traces if we surface sampling transparently and allow on-demand retrieval (tiered retrieval/backfill).

danielle (PM): Good points. Options: A) Ship dashboards + traces (90d sampled, retrieval API) + postpone heatmaps. B) Ship full 90d traces but limit retention for small orgs only (costly). Recommended A. Any blockers?

mike (Eng - obs): Blockers: storage infra for retrieval API and index changes. ETA for A is ~6 weeks with 2 engs + 1 infra. We can get a prototype in 3 weeks for internal review.

tara (SRE): We need rollout plan + canary for retention policy. Suggest feature flag per org and automated cost alerts.

danielle (PM): Launch criteria proposal: 1) core dashboards finalized + docs, 2) trace waterfall + sampling visible, 3) retrieval API basic, 4) canary on 10% of orgs, 5) automated cost guardrails. OKR check: this maps to Observability Q4 objective (reduce ops-to-triage by 30%).

raj (Data): Add: include a small eval set with known regressions so we can catch sampling-related blindspots.

sam (Design): I'll prepare microcopy + in-console banner explaining sampling behavior + link to docs.

olivia (Customer Success): I'll brief the two enterprise customers and see if they want to join canary.

deploy-bot: New canary flag created: feature.obs.trace_sampling_canary, set to 0.1 by default.

danielle (PM): Cool. Action items: mike+tara -> infra rollout plan (due in 5d), raj -> eval set (7d), sam -> copy + banner (4d), olivia -> customer outreach (3d). I'll update roadmap doc and okr row. :thumbsup: 

mike (Eng - obs): Noted. Posting rough infra checklist in #eng-infra after this.

raj (Data): Will share eval CSV link once ready.

sam (Design): Will post banner mock in #design in 48h.

olivia (Customer Success): Scheduling customer calls now.

danielle (PM): Thanks all. If anyone thinks full retention is non-negotiable for a paying customer, flag now. Otherwise proceed with Option A. :eyes: 

mike (Eng - obs): No objections from infra side.

tara (SRE): 👍

olivia (Customer Success): 👍

danielle (PM): Closing thread. Will set follow-up sync on Friday.
